steps.objective: Implement oil/gas monthly total and entity growth dbt marts with documented grains. Daily oil bbl and gas million m3 are converted in dbt. Exact calendar joins for YoY/MoM; entity full union for entry/exit; no lag(12) on sparse. New models fct_production_month and fct_entity_growth (fluid, dimension, entity_id, periodo) should expose volume, rate, prior volume/rate, signed growth deltas and percentages, positive-producing wells, completeness/coverage. Explicit month acceptance comes from source/profile manifest or approved_period var; not max raw only. Historical names use id and latest name with traceability; fix dimensions tests rejecting legitimate renames (preserve identity integrity). Add dbt tests for reconciliation including rates/deltas, unit tests for missing months/leap/base-zero/entry-exit. Also build a portable offline dbt verification path (DuckDB, only these publication models, reuse SQL via macros/adapters; BigQuery remains primary), fed official normalized QA source or test fixture. No fake published data, no cloud writes. Include transform/publication/export_release.py to export these marts, validate aggregate reconciliation and build manifest/versioned JSON candidate, no business formulas outside dbt. Keep previous models/pipeline supported.

steps.objective: Build production Next.js static export editorial Barrilito in apps/web. Read specs/002-portfolio and ADR 0003 first, confirmed grill-me and antislop DURING so do not interview again/install globals. Oil default / Gas switch changes EVERY metric, chart, contribution/table; units bbl/d+bbl and MMm3/d+MMm3. Initial trend12 months selector12/24/36/60, only valid available ranges. Recharts for line gaps and signed contributions. Latest accepted month, YoY primary MoM secondary; date/source visible. Top5 monthly production with volume YoY; dimension tabs company/area; contributions full dataset including negatives/rest. Top5 concentration share with pp YoY if available. Responsive editorial typographic hierarchy, light paper/ink and deliberate domain accent, no SaaS card grid or decorative gradients. Methodology/source/revisions/data download; keyboard labels/focus, accessible equivalent text/table, empty/error/loading. Strict runtime schema from export contract; no raw/GCP credentials, NO metric recomputation in frontend (format/sort/presentation only). If live candidate not yet present use honest empty state and test fixtures visibly isolated; do not pretend fixture is official. Add scoped conversational analytics deterministic prepared questions over public aggregates with source/formula/period and rejection outside scope. Add meaningful unit and browser test scripts and write design rationale. No changes outside apps/web. Install dependencies necessary from npm and run build/tests, screenshots only if possible. Do not deploy.
